facts.text: Rancho Santana's ocean-view homes are set across 2,700 acres of Nicaragua's Emerald Coast.
facts.excerpt: Rancho Santana’s luxury ocean-view homes are private vacation rentals set across 2,700 acres of Nicaragua’s Emerald Coast.

facts.text: Guests have access to five beaches.
facts.excerpt: Guests have access to five beautiful beaches, farm-to-table dining, outdoor activities, and a landscape that encourages both adventure and calm moments.

facts.text: Rancho Santana has three surf beaches on the property: Playa Los Perros, Playa Santana and Playa Rosada.
facts.excerpt: Rancho Santana has three surf beaches on the property: Playa Los Perros, Playa Santana, and Playa Rosada.

facts.text: Playa Los Perros offers approachable waves and is home to the resort's Surf Shop, lessons and rentals.
facts.excerpt: Playa Los Perros offers approachable waves and is home to Rancho Santana’s Surf Shop, lessons, and rentals.

facts.text: Playa Rosada is known for its left point break.
facts.excerpt: Known for its left point break, Playa Rosada offers another surf experience for guests

facts.text: Rancho Santana offers surf lessons, professional coaching, guided surf experiences and surf-focused packages.
facts.excerpt: Rancho Santana offers surf lessons, professional coaching, guided surf experiences, and surf-focused packages

facts.text: Each of the Inn's rooms has a private terrace and furniture made by local artisans at the on-site woodshop.
facts.excerpt: each of the Inn’s rooms has a private terrace and is outfitted with furniture made by local artisans at our on-site woodshop.

facts.text: The Inn is Rancho Santana's boutique hotel at the center of the resort's walkable village.
facts.excerpt: The Inn is Rancho Santana’s boutique luxury hotel, offering an intimate stay at the center of the resort’s walkable village.

facts.text: The Inn's Pacific Suite has a soaking tub and a private terrace with wraparound ocean views.
facts.excerpt: One bedroom/one bathroom suite with additional seating area, private ocean view terrace, and soaking tub.

facts.text: The ocean-view homes range from three to nine bedrooms, with options for beachfront access and private pools.
facts.excerpt: Homes range from three to nine bedrooms and sleep 6 to 18 guests, with options for beachfront access, private pools, and walkable proximity to the Clubhouse and beaches.

facts.text: La Casa Mas Alta sits atop seven private acres at Rancho Santana's highest point.
facts.excerpt: This scenic sanctuary sits atop seven private acres at Rancho Santana’s highest point.

facts.text: The Pacific Condos have ocean views and easy access to Playa Santana.
facts.excerpt: The Pacific Condos boast ocean views and easy access to Playa Santana.

facts.text: The Garden-View Casitas are surrounded by tropical foliage and have fully equipped kitchens.
facts.excerpt: these casitas are surrounded by tropical foliage and feature fully equipped kitchens.

facts.text: The Spa in El Bosque is a 6,000-square-foot spa and wellness sanctuary built into the resort's hillside.
facts.excerpt: Our 6,000-square-foot spa and wellness sanctuary is built into Rancho Santana’s rugged hillside

facts.text: Rancho Santana has a treetop yoga palapa.
facts.excerpt: Find Zen in our treetop yoga palapa

facts.text: The gym, FunLimon, is across the street from Rancho Santana.

facts.text: A stay includes complimentary access to the tennis and pickleball courts, the Las Cinco Playas Tour and monkey spotting.
facts.excerpt: your stay includes complimentary access to our tennis and pickleball courts, Las Cinco Playas Tour, monkey spotting, and so much more.

facts.text: Signature experiences include a sunset horseback ride.
facts.excerpt: Enhance your stay with added activities, including a sunset horseback ride, surf lesson, and massage in our forest spa sanctuary.

facts.text: Off-site guided tours go to volcanoes, lake islands and in search of sloths.
facts.excerpt: Our off-site guided tours will take you to volcanoes, lake islands, and in search of sloths.

facts.text: Stays include complimentary Kids Club access for ages 5 to 12.
